name: Threat Incursion
author: Tristan
description: The Threat does not stay in the abyss. Once woken, the fabricator swarms colonize the sector's fringe - founding real colonies that mine, refine, and forge for a closed hive economy - then strike outward at inhabited space, converging on the core worlds. Fight the network, not just the fleets: cut its supply chains, sabotage expeditions in fabrication, and lay siege to the entrenched hives - suppress their war-strata, land marines on their organs, and starve them into decline until the strata go cold. Standalone; pairs with Remnant Retribution. Configurable via LunaLib (optional).
